# Scraper output contract

Every scraper writes one JSON file per paper via `common.write_paper()`
into `scraper/data/<board>/<class>/<subject_slug>/<id>.json`.
The website's seed script ingests exactly this shape, so do not invent fields.

## Boards (URL slugs)

| slug    | body   | classes |
|---------|--------|---------|
| `cbse`  | CBSE   | 9–12    |
| `icse`  | CISCE  | 9–10    |
| `isc`   | CISCE  | 11–12   |
| `up`    | UPMSP (UP Board) | 9–12 |
| `bihar` | BSEB (Bihar Board) | 9–12 |

## Paper record

```jsonc
{
  "id": "cbse-10-science-2025-sample-en",   // generated by Paper.id
  "board": "cbse",
  "class": 10,
  "subject_slug": "science",                 // canonical slug from common.SUBJECTS
  "subject_name": {"en": "Science", "hi": "विज्ञान"},
  "year": 2025,                              // exam year (session 2024-25 -> 2025)
  "session": "2024-25",
  "kind": "sample",                          // pyq | sample | specimen | model
  "lang": "en",                              // en | hi | bi (bilingual paper)
  "variant": null,                           // e.g. "30/1/1", "Set A", "Delhi"
  "title": "Sample Question Paper ...",      // title as published
  "source_page": "https://...",              // official page that lists the paper (attribution)
  "paper_pdf": "https://...",                // official direct PDF URL
  "solution_pdf": "https://..." | null,      // official marking scheme / answer key
  "duration_minutes": 180,
  "max_marks": 80,
  "extraction": "full",                      // full | questions | pdf-only
  "questions": [
    {
      "number": "1",                         // as printed: "1", "14", "2(a)"
      "section": "A",                        // or null
      "marks": 1,                            // or null
      "text": "...",                         // plain text, line breaks preserved, MCQ options on own lines
      "solution": "..." | null,              // ONLY from the official marking scheme / answer key
      "has_figure": false,                   // true if question needs a diagram/graph/table from the PDF
      "page": 3                              // 1-based PDF page where the question starts
    }
  ],
  "scraped_at": "2026-11-08T22:00:00+00:00"
}
```

`kind` meanings:
- `pyq` — an actual board exam paper from a past year
- `sample` — CBSE Sample Question Paper (SQP)
- `specimen` — CISCE specimen paper
- `model` — UP / Bihar board model paper or model question bank

## Quality rules (important)

1. **Official sources only.** `Fetcher` refuses non-official domains. Do not pull
   questions or solutions from third-party sites (LearnCBSE, Vedantu, Shaalaa,
   Jagran Josh, BYJU'S, SelfStudys, etc.) — their solutions are copyrighted.
2. **No garbage text.** Run `looks_garbled()` on extracted text. Scanned PDFs and
   legacy Hindi fonts (Kruti Dev etc.) must become `extraction: "pdf-only"` with
   an empty `questions` list. A clean PDF-only record is far better than mojibake.
3. **Never mismatch solutions.** Only attach a marking-scheme answer when its
   question number matches unambiguously. Otherwise leave `solution: null`.
4. Strip page headers/footers, page numbers, "P.T.O.", watermarks, and the
   general-instructions block from question text.
5. Be polite: `Fetcher` already throttles (1 req/s/host), caches, and checks
   robots.txt. Do not lower `min_interval`.
6. Scrapers must be re-runnable (`python scraper/<board>/scrape.py`) and
   idempotent — reruns overwrite the same files.
